description: This file defines types, constants, and utility functions related to legacy configuration rules, migrations, and data handling within a software project. It includes type definitions for rules, migrations, and their specifications, as well as functions for data validation, merging, extraction, and normalization relevant to legacy configurations.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Safely retrieves a record from a given value if it passes the 'isRecord' check, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: ensureRecord
methods.description: Ensures that a specified key in a root object contains a record. If the key does not exist or is not a record, it initializes it as an empty record.

methods.name: mergeMissing
methods.description: Merges properties from a source record into a target record, skipping undefined values and blocked object keys, and recurses into nested records.

methods.name: mapLegacyAudioTranscription
methods.description: Processes a value to extract and structure command info if the value conforms to expected format, returning null otherwise.

methods.name: getAgentsList
methods.description: Extracts the list of agents from a record, returning an empty array if absent or invalid.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentIdFromRaw
methods.description: Determines the default agent ID from raw configuration data with a priority order: explicit default in agents, routing default, first agent, or 'main'.

methods.name: ensureAgentEntry
methods.description: Finds or creates an agent entry in a list with a specified ID.

methods.name: defineLegacyConfigMigration
methods.description: Wrapper to specify or confirm a legacy configuration migration.
